amendments.what: `_file_of` tested `locator.endswith('.xml')` to decide whether a citation was a schema reference. A schema locator is `common.xml:MESSAGE.field`, so the field name comes last and the test was always false: the verifier treated `common.xml` as a source path and raised FileNotFoundError on the first B2 candidate.
amendments.what_it_DOES_affect: Nothing that was measured before the fix. It made the B2/B3 defect-discovery pass runnable at all; that pass had produced no numbers before.
amendments.why_it_is_not_a_result_change: The hallucination fixtures cite only source files, never schema locators, so the containment path was never reached. Containment was re-run after the fix and every fixture produced the identical phase-1 verdict: 6/6 SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, 6/6 stopped before phase 2.

why_this_file_exists: FREEZE.json is left byte-for-byte as it was committed before the reference existed -- it is the ordering evidence and must not be rewritten. Any change to a frozen artifact AFTER that point is recorded here instead, with the reason, so `freeze.py --check` reporting drift is explained rather than explained away.
